messages:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER — P1: routing-service detected sustained quality-slo errors for requests routed to low-cost variants (~14:02 UTC). Auto-pager triggered, paging on-call.

maria (oncall): on it. acked the pager and pulling logs. tagging alex and raj.

maria (oncall): quick summary: sudden jump in user-facing quality errors since ~13:58. Traffic shifted ~20% -> cheap variant 'gptq-8k-eco-v2'. We have customer complaints about bad summaries.

alex (ml-eng): looking. early signal: policy evaluation shows cost-first routing rule matched more aggressively after routing-policy optimizer pushed new thresholds at 13:55. I can see a variant score estimator mis-calibrated (quality_estimate dropped).

alex (ml-eng): snippet from routing config that rolled out (diff):
```yaml
- id: cost_tier_cheap
  match: cost_expectation <= 0.02
  action: prefer_variant
  variant: gptq-8k-eco-v2
  fallback: cheapest_compatible
```

alex (ml-eng): the optimizer also enabled fallback loops: if cheapest_compatible returns a model not meeting min_quality it tries next-cheapest - but because min_quality threshold was missing for the cheap tier, fallback loop kept pushing to even cheaper variants.

maria (oncall): evidence of customer failures? tara, any CS tickets?

tara (support): yes - we have 3 elevated tickets from customers in EU complaining about hallucinations and degraded summarization quality. All started ~14:00 UTC. I've opened INC-4921, INC-4922, INC-4923 and linked sample payloads.

lee (product): impact estimate? percent of requests failing QA checks?

ops-bot: Monitor: quality_slo_violation_rate for route /v1/generate spiked from 0.6% -> 6.8% (5-min avg) at 13:59 UTC.

alex (ml-eng): confirmed. replayed a batch of traffic to candidates: golden -> high-quality variant yields expected outputs; gptq-8k-eco-v2 returns truncated/incoherent outputs on ~18% of checks.

raj (sre): mitigation plan suggestions: 1) revert optimizer thresholds, 2) add a short-term guard to routing policy to require min_quality >= 0.88, 3) throttle cheap-tier to <5% until we validate. Which do we want now?

maria (oncall): do 1 + 2 now. rollback the optimizer rollout and apply a policy hotfix. I will run the rollback and apply guard.

alex (ml-eng): on it. running:
```bash
# revert routing optimizer rollout
redwoodctl rollout revert --component=routing-optimizer --to=deployment/optimizer@2026-11-04T13:50:00Z
# apply policy guard
redwoodctl routing update --route /v1/generate --set "policy.filters.min_quality=0.88"
```

ops-bot: Action logged: rollback command submitted by alex at 14:08 UTC.

maria (oncall): monitoring after change. ops-bot, give me quality_slo_violation_rate and cheap-variant traffic percentage.

ops-bot: metrics (14:12 UTC): quality_slo_violation_rate -> 3.1% (down from 6.8%). cheap_variant_traffic -> 6.4% (down from 20%).

lee (product): good. any risk to availability from rollback?

raj (sre): low. rollback is config-only and policy-level. no infra change.

alex (ml-eng): extra step: disabled auto-fallback-to-cheapest for the route while we investigate scoring model.
```yaml
# temp override
routing.overrides:/v1/generate:
  fallback_policy: disabled
  max_cheap_share: 0.05
```

maria (oncall): customer comms? tara, can you notify impacted customers that we're mitigating and will follow up with details?

tara (support): sending short note now. created a shared doc with examples and ETA for follow-up.

maria (oncall): monitoring window for next 30m. if violation rate <1% for 30m we consider resolved and will unpage.

ops-bot: metrics update (14:28 UTC): quality_slo_violation_rate -> 0.9%. cheap_variant_traffic -> 3.9%.

maria (oncall): marking incident as mitigated. will keep thread open for handoff and root cause investigation.

lee (product): we should prioritize a safety check in routing optimizer: publish a hard minimum quality floor for any auto-cost policy + integration test in canary.

alex (ml-eng): agreed. immediate follow-ups: (A) retrain/calibrate the quality_estimator used by optimizer, (B) add unit test for policy that ensures min_quality present when cost-first rules exist, (C) add canary gating to optimizer.

raj (sre): operational follow-ups: add Alert: routing-policy-change => new rollback link in pager, and document runbook steps for toggling max_cheap_share.

maria (oncall): handoff time: I need to sign off in 12m. raj, you take overnight oncall. I will add runbook notes and link to incident doc.

raj (sre): taking handoff. I'll keep watch and will escalate to eng if metrics degrade. pls include the commands you ran in the incident doc.

maria (oncall): done. incident doc: https://redwood-internal/incidents/1967890123 — includes timeline, commands used, sample inputs, and cs tickets.

tara (support): CS update sent to affected customers. we offered rollback to previous model variant for one high-touch customer and scheduled a follow-up call.

lee (product): thumbs up. add PM owning the optimizer fixes (assigned to me).

maria (oncall): unpaging. continuing as mitigated. will lead postmortem tomorrow 15:00 UTC. thanks all for quick responses. :white_check_mark:
